Tooltip_Whisp_Guts: Heavy, slick and rotting. Smear them on to hide among the dead.
Tooltip_Whisp_CorpseHead: Cut off the face with a short blade, take out the brain with a knife, or put it on a stake.
Tooltip_Whisp_CorpseHeadFaceless: The face is gone. Take out the brain with a knife, or put it on a stake as a warning to the living.
Tooltip_Whisp_CorpseFace: Sew it into a mask with a needle (or a nail) and thread, twine, fishing line, dental floss or wire.
Tooltip_Whisp_FaceMask: Wearing a dead face makes your gore count five times over, but everything past arm's reach goes blurry through the eye holes. Tears with wear and dries out over time; treat it with brain tan to stop the drying. Repair with Tailoring 5.
Tooltip_Whisp_SkinSuit: Wearing dead skin makes your gore count ten times over. Nothing but head gear, shoes and socks goes on with it. Wears down and dries out over time; treat it with brain tan to stop the drying. A hard hit can tear it apart.
Tooltip_Whisp_CorpseBrain: Works like an animal brain for making brain tan. A zombie's brain is infected; a player's holds some of what they knew.
Tooltip_Whisp_HeadStake: Right-click it and choose Place. A hat or mask can go on the head. Disassembling it will likely break the head or the stick.
